title: Edamame Hummus with Garlic Scapes
description: This edamame hummus with garlic scapes recipe is an inventive, delicious version of hummus made with edamame, cashews, and fresh garden garlic scapes.
ingredients: 1 (16 ounce) package frozen shelled edamame (green soybeans)
5 tablespoons cashews, or more to taste
1 cup green garlic (garlic scapes), cut into pieces
1 small lemon, finely zested and juiced
0.75 cup extra-virgin olive oil, or more as needed

steps.text: Bring 6 cups water to a boil in a large saucepan. Add edamame; cook until soft, 4 to 5 minutes. Drain; refrigerate to cool, 10 minutes.
Combine cashews and 1 teaspoon salt in the bowl of a food processor; pulse until finely chopped, scraping the sides of bowl as needed.
Add edamame, garlic scapes, lemon zest, lemon juice, remaining 2 teaspoons salt, 1 teaspoon black pepper, and coriander; pulse until reaches desired consistency.
Pour ¾ cup oil in slowly with processor running until hummus is smooth; season with oil, salt, and black pepper.
